scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web & bun run dev:worker & wait
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run test:scripts
scripts.db:up: ssh oracle 'mkdir -p ~/uniloom' && scp -q docker-compose.yml oracle:uniloom/ && ssh oracle 'cd ~/uniloom && echo DB_HOST_IP=$(tailscale ip -4) > .env && sudo docker compose up -d --wait db'
scripts.db:down: ssh oracle 'cd ~/uniloom && sudo docker compose stop db'
scripts.setup: bun scripts/setup-env.mjs && bun run db:local && bun run uniauth:migrate && bun run db:generate && bun run api:generate && bun run db:deploy
scripts.dev:local: bun run db:local && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n uniauth,api,web,worker,ready -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,white "bun run uniauth:dev" "bun scripts/wait-for-uniauth.mjs && bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:worker" "bun scripts/wait-for-ready.mjs"
scripts.uniauth:install: cd ../uniAuth && NODE_AUTH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bun install

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bunx lint-staged && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
